gen-gf-courier-prime-satoshi: Fixed-width and measured, Courier Prime ticks through every word at a spaced-out beat, with no thinning strokes. But Satoshi, a sans with a soaring x-height and a wide-open e, would carry page after page without looking squeezed.
gen-gf-cousine-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans stands sturdy and tall, its e opening clearly to the right. And Cousine, with each glyph isolated by generous blank space, supplies the precise, technical edge that sets this pair apart.
gen-gf-cousine-fs-supreme: Spaced-out and precise, Cousine isolates each glyph in generous blank, while Supreme runs a thick, heavy-looking band of text. Cousine keeps things technical; Supreme keeps its letters held open.
gen-gf-cousine-manrope: Precise from the first glyph, Cousine sits tall at the waist with generous blank around each letter. Manrope, a plain sans, holds one steady pen line throughout, its curves opening brightly against all that precision.
gen-gf-cousine-satoshi: Cousine isolates each typewriter-like glyph in generous blank, precise and technical, while Satoshi's wire-like strokes never thicken or thin. The plain sans below, tall and open, gives the grid room.
gen-gf-days-one-fs-erode: Days One lifts its lowercase high above the capitals, spaced far apart. Erode, a serif with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders, adds a gentle ebb and flow of stroke weight beneath it.
gen-gf-days-one-fs-karma: Days One stands modern and clean, with big lowercase and scattered letters. Karma, a serif whose hairlines are only somewhat lighter than its stems, never snags the eye beneath it.
gen-gf-dhurjati-fs-karma: Dhurjati keeps its contrast moderate and its default spacing tight, with small-looking capitals sitting beside big lowercase letters. Karma, a serif, brings classic, trustworthy terminals set clear of the stem.
gen-gf-do-hyeon-fs-karma: Rope-coiled lowercase letters hug one another in Do Hyeon, a flat gray hum of constant line weight. Karma, the text serif, shades its round and straight strokes moderately, so paragraphs glide without a snag.
gen-gf-domine-archivo: Domine blows its lowercase bowls tall, like glass bulbs. Archivo, a sans with a commanding x-height, lets curves open outward instead of curling in, so paragraphs move along readily.
